notVoted.title: Eternl needs your support.
notVoted.text: Your DRep hasn't voted yet. Please reach out to your DRep to tell them you care about supporting Eternl's proposal. Or choose (even temporarily) a DRep who already voted YES.

abstain.title: Join Cardano’s liquid governance.
abstain.text: You can help us out: Delegate to a DRep voting YES to fund Eternl.
